abort.no_bluetooth_vehicles: No Teslemetry vehicle is paired over Bluetooth. Add a Bluetooth vehicle to the Teslemetry integration first.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Teslemetry Bluetooth Commands is already set up. It covers every Teslemetry vehicle paired over Bluetooth.

user.description: Add Bluetooth-only command entities to every Teslemetry vehicle that is paired over Bluetooth. The commands use Teslemetry's Bluetooth connection and never fall back to the cloud.

bluetooth_failed.message: {vehicle} was not reached over Bluetooth: {error}. The command was not sent to the cloud.

command_no_response.message: {vehicle} did not return a result for the Bluetooth command. Check the vehicle's state in Teslemetry before you try again.

incompatible_teslemetry.message: The installed Teslemetry integration does not provide the Bluetooth connection this integration needs (missing: {missing}). Install Teslemetry from {version} or later.

not_in_range.message: {vehicle} was not reached over Bluetooth: it is not in Bluetooth range. The command was not sent to the cloud.

incompatible_teslemetry.description: The installed Teslemetry integration does not provide the Bluetooth connection that Teslemetry Bluetooth Commands needs (missing: {missing}). No Bluetooth command entities were added. Install Teslemetry from {version} or later, then restart Home Assistant.
incompatible_teslemetry.title: Teslemetry Bluetooth Commands needs a newer Teslemetry
